data.body: Closing per evaluation: root cause (reconciler scheduled runs failing with fatal HTTP 404 on stale-binding update) was fixed by commit 3de0b8ff3f (soft-fail HTTP 404), on main since today. Recent validation: reconciler scheduled + dispatched passes now SUCCEED (green; e.g. runs 27045411865/27046732036) and a quiescent pass reached 0 mutations. The 'no successful run within 2h' staleness condition no longer holds. (The canary would also auto-close this on next recovery detection.)
